raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Human Summary

Fix CI breakage due to Triton default value change. Set the env value explicitly to avoid another breakage.

## AI Summary

- Enable Triton FP fusion explicitly in B200 CI.
- Refresh the Kimi K3 B200 loss and gradient norm reference from full-precision TensorBoard values.
- Run the existing KDA forward and backward accuracy test on B200.
- Keep the strict ten-step training comparison.

## Why

Triton https://github.com/triton-lang/triton/pull/12387 changes the fusion default from disabled to enabled. The Kimi K3 DistMuon test uses Triton kernels without an explicit fusion setting.

Two nightly runs produce identical enabled-fusion loss and gradient norm values:

- https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/actions/runs/40148031206
- https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/actions/runs/40250914092

The diagnostic run with `TRITON_DEFAULT_FP_FUSION=0` restores all ten values in the disabled-fusion reference exactly: https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/actions/runs/40408976642.

The reference uses the enabled-fusion values from the second nightly run. Explicit `TRITON_DEFAULT_FP_FUSION=1` keeps the reference stable across Triton default changes. The KDA accuracy test compares forward outputs and all input gradients against an independent FP32 recurrence before the strict training comparison.

## Validation

- All ten loss and gradient norm values in the reference match the source TensorBoard artifact exactly.
- Workflow YAML, Bash syntax, and `git diff --check` pass.
- `pre-commit run --all-files`: all hooks pass except Pyrefly, which reports 27 dependency/API errors in unchanged Python files in the local environment.
- The KDA forward and backward accuracy test passes on H100 with fusion disabled and enabled. Versions: Torch `2.16.0.dev20261025+cu130`, Triton `3.9.0+git0a6e13e6`, Attention Gym `0.0.17`.
- B200 validation passes with fusion enabled: https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/actions/runs/40467443089. All ten losses and gradient norms match the refreshed reference exactly. The KDA FP32 reference test passes, all 62 unit tests pass, and all integration runs pass. Versions: Torch `2.16.0.dev20261026+cu130`, Triton `3.9.0+git0a6e13e6`.
- GitHub lint passes: https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/actions/runs/40467382873.
- GraphTrainer B200 passes: https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/actions/runs/40467443013.
- RL B200 passes: https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/actions/runs/40467443122.

           enable-cache: true
 
       - name: Run B200 integration tests

+          # Keep the historical default value (before 2026/09/23).
+          # The default was 1 before 2026/09/23 and was changed to
+          # 0 but was changed again to 1 on 2026/10/20.
+          # Set to 1 to avoid another breakage in the future.
+          TRITON_DEFAULT_FP_FUSION: "1"

           set -eux
